t: What Grid Equipment Compatibility Database Is All About
title: What Grid Equipment Compatibility Database Is All About
description: Grid equipment must agree electrically: voltage classes (120V to 765kV), short-circuit ratings, CT/PT ratios, and communication protocols (DNP3, IEC 61850). Mismatched breakers fail to clear faults; wrong-ratio CTs blind protection. Interoperability standards let multi-vendor substations work as one. The register: ratings, connections, and the standards binding them. This database is the complete equipment compatibility: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
